title: Trump Is Said to Have Directed Effort to Reinstate Nvidia Chief
title_en: Trump Is Said to Have Directed Effort to Reinstate Nvidia Chief

inline_images.caption: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as president and chief executive on Monday. (Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times)
inline_images.alt: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as president and chief executive on Monday.

inline_images.caption: The company’s stock was up more than 30 percent on Monday. (Angela Weiss/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images)
inline_images.alt: The company’s stock was up more than 30 percent on Monday.

inline_images.caption: Mr. Trump has sought to separate Mr. Huang from the investigations into chip smuggling. (Demetrius Freeman for The New York Times)
inline_images.alt: Mr. Trump has sought to separate Mr. Huang from the investigations into chip smuggling.

author: Maggie Haberman and Jonathan Swan
article_content:
Jensen Huang was reappointed as chief executive of Nvidia after President Trump set in motion several days of maneuvering to provide the company’s board with assurances that Mr. Huang was not facing criminal charges and did not pose a national security risk, according to two people with knowledge of the matter.

Late last week, Mr. Trump decided he wanted to do whatever he could to help Mr. Huang get his old job back, the people said, despite concerns from his own national security agencies about Mr. Huang’s affair with a woman they believed to be a Chinese intelligence asset and who was also believed to be involved in possible illegal smuggling of Nvidia chips into China.

Over the weekend, Mr. Trump asked Vice President JD Vance to talk to Mr. Huang and work with Nvidia’s board to resolve the situation. Mr. Vance spoke privately with Mr. Huang over the weekend and helped the Nvidia board get the assurances it needed that the Trump administration did not believe that Mr. Huang himself posed a national security risk. Only a tiny handful of officials at the highest level of the government were aware of these conversations.

On Sunday night, Nvidia’s board told the administration that it would be announcing Mr. Huang’s reinstatement on Monday morning before the markets opened. The announcement included a note about a new compliance committee, intended to offer public assurance that the company was taking seriously the investigation into the possible smuggling of advanced chips. Mr. Trump was said to have been thrilled that the plan to restore Mr. Huang was executed without any leaks.

In directing Mr. Vance to engage with Mr. Huang and his peers, Mr. Trump was turning to one of the members of his administration with the strongest relationships in Silicon Valley. The vice president is close to some of Mr. Huang’s biggest supporters and admirers, such as David Sacks, the investor and co-chairman of the President’s Council of Advisers on Science and Technology. Mr. Sacks previously served as Mr. Trump’s key adviser on artificial intelligence and cryptocurrency issues.

Representatives for Mr. Huang and Mr. Vance declined to comment. A spokesman for Nvidia did not respond to an email seeking comment.

On Monday morning, Mr. Trump rejoiced in Nvidia’s action, saying on his social media website Truth Social that the company “made the correct and proper decision.” The president explicitly connected the reinstatement of Mr. Huang to the health of the U.S. economy.

“The Country needs Jensen’s leadership at NVIDIA in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy,” Mr. Trump wrote.

Mr. Trump has sought to separate Mr. Huang from the investigations into chip smuggling that his government is pursuing. As The New York Times has previously reported, the U.S. intelligence community has collected evidence that a Chinese woman, Alice Huang, was in contact with China’s top spy agency for more than a year while she was having a secret affair with the Nvidia chief executive. But the Trump administration did not give Mr. Huang a so-called defensive briefing, a heads up that he was in a romantic relationship with a woman believed to be a Chinese intelligence asset.

The Singapore-based company that Ms. Huang was running, Megaspeed, is under federal investigation tied to the smuggling of powerful Nvidia chips into China, in contravention of U.S. export laws.

Mr. Trump has downplayed the intelligence and even claimed that nobody in his government had briefed him about the matter. In fact, advisers to Mr. Trump, including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, briefed him at least twice about the national security concerns surrounding Mr. Huang’s relationship with Ms. Huang.

Mr. Huang admitted earlier his month to infidelities after initially casting his dealings with Ms. Huang as a business relationship. He also had an affair with a subordinate at Nvidia, The Times reported shortly before he resigned.

“The United States government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to Nvidia poses any risk to national security,” Mr. Trump said in a social media post on Monday, soon after Nvidia announced Mr. Huang’s return. “The attorney general of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct.”

In a brief telephone interview on Monday morning, Mr. Trump exulted in the decision by the board. “Did I do a good job last night?” he asked.

“I just thought he should be running the company, and I didn’t know it was going to have this kind of an impact,” the president said. “I’ve never seen anything quite like it actually. The stock is up.”

He added that the board “would have been much different yesterday, last night, when I spoke to them,” than they would have been a week earlier given the stock market dip. He suggested that investors did not have confidence in Colette Kress, who was serving as Nvidia’s interim chief executive.

The president remarked that Ms. Kress “gave a rough interview” with Jim Cramer of CNBC.

Mr. Trump declined to answer questions about whether he believes that Ms. Huang was working with Chinese intelligence agencies. He also declined to discuss what he himself had been told by Mr. Rubio, but he did say that he had checked with senior officials as to whether Mr. Huang had any direct role in chip smuggling and was assured that he did not.

“All those guys knew about it,” Mr. Trump said, specifically citing Attorney General Todd Blanche and Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence. “I had to go to them before I recommended this. Look, I can’t do this and then all of a sudden have somebody get indicted for, for whatever.”

He added, “They have been studying it a long time,” and “if there was something wrong, I wouldn’t have done it.”

He emphasized that Mr. Huang, in his view, made a mistake by stepping down.

“I wouldn’t have handled it the way he handled it,” Mr. Trump told The Times of Mr. Huang, referring to his decision to step down. “The Peyton Place part,” the president said, a reference to the 1960s-era soap opera based on a novel about a town roiled in constant sex scandals.

“Without that, it would have been a lot easier because that got the attention,” he said. “You know, sex was involved, and sex sells better than stocks.”

Mr. Trump also said that Mr. Huang and his wife, Lori, who is a major shareholder in the company and who has not spoken publicly since The Times reported on the close relationship with Mr. Huang and Alice Huang, have “worked it out.”

“He’s got a very, very, very good wife, and they’ve worked it out,” Mr. Trump said. “She’s a fantastic woman.”

article_content_zh:
据两位知情人士透露，特朗普总统采取了几天的行动，向该公司董事会保证黄仁勋没有面临刑事指控，也不会构成国家安全风险，之后，黄仁勋被重新任命为英伟达首席执行官。

知情人士称，上周晚些时候，特朗普决定尽一切努力帮助黄先生恢复原来的工作，尽管他自己的国家安全机构对黄先生与一名女性的婚外情感到担忧，他们认为黄先生是中国情报人员，而且据信该女性还参与了可能将英伟达芯片非法走私到中国的活动。

周末，特朗普要求副总裁 JD Vance 与黄先生交谈，并与 Nvidia 董事会合作解决这一问题。万斯周末与黄先生私下交谈，并帮助英伟达董事会获得所需的保证，即特朗普政府不认为黄先生本人构成国家安全风险。只有极少数政府最高层官员知道这些谈话。

周日晚上，英伟达董事会告诉政府，它将在周一早上开盘前宣布黄先生复职。该公告包括关于新成立合规委员会的说明，旨在向公众保证该公司正在认真对待可能走私先进芯片的调查。据说，让黄先生复职的计划没有任何泄密地得到执行，让特朗普感到非常兴奋。

在指示万斯先生与黄先生及其同僚接触时，特朗普先生转向了他的政府中在硅谷关​​系最牢固的成员之一。这位副总统与黄先生的一些最大支持者和崇拜者关系密切，例如总统科学技术顾问委员会的投资者兼联合主席戴维·萨克斯(David Sacks)。萨克斯先生此前曾担任特朗普先生在人工智能和加密货币问题上的重要顾问。

黄先生和万斯先生的代表拒绝置评。英伟达发言人没有回复寻求置评的电子邮件。

周一早上，特朗普对英伟达的行动感到高兴，他在社交媒体网站 Truth Social 上表示，该公司“做出了正确且恰当的决定”。总统明确将黄先生的复职与美国经济的健康联系起来。

“国家需要 Jensen 在 NVIDIA 的领导，以确保公司和美国经济的成功和繁荣，”特朗普写道。

特朗普试图将黄先生从他的政府正在进行的芯片走私调查中分离出来。正如《纽约时报》此前报道的那样，美国情报界已经收集到证据，证明一名名叫爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的中国女子在与英伟达（Nvidia）首席执行官有秘密恋情期间，与中国最高间谍机构保持了一年多的联系。但特朗普政府没有给黄做所谓的防御性简报，即提醒他与一名据信是中国情报人员的女子有恋爱关系。

黄女士经营的新加坡公司 Megaspeed 正在接受联邦调查，该公司涉嫌向中国走私强大的 Nvidia 芯片，这违反了美国出口法。

特朗普淡化了这一情报，甚至声称政府中没有人向他通报过此事。事实上，特朗普的顾问，包括国务卿马可·卢比奥，至少两次向他介绍了围绕黄先生与黄女士关系的国家安全担忧。

本月早些时候，黄先生承认自己有不忠行为，此前他最初将与黄女士的交往视为业务关系。据《泰晤士报》在他辞职前不久报道，他还与英伟达的一名下属有染。

“美国政府没有理由相信詹森重返英伟达会对国家安全构成任何风险，”周一，在英伟达宣布黄仁勋回归后不久，特朗普在社交媒体上发帖表示。 “美国总检察长已确认，美国政府没有证据表明他有任何非法行为。”

在周一早上的简短电话采访中，特朗普对董事会的决定感到欣喜若狂。 “我昨晚表现不错吗？”他问道。

title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Days After Board Ruled Out His Return
title_en: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Days After Board Ruled Out His Return

inline_images.caption: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Days After Board Ruled Out His Return (Photo: REUTERS)
inline_images.caption_en: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Days After Board Ruled Out His Return (Photo: REUTERS)
inline_images.caption_zh: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Days After Board Ruled Out His Return (摄影：路透社)
inline_images.alt: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Days After Board Ruled Out His Return

author: Reuters
article_content:
Nvidia's board has reinstated Jensen Huang as president and CEO, six days after its chair said directors did not intend to bring him back.

The board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang as president, CEO and a board member, effective immediately, the company said on Monday. It followed "a series of discussions and meetings" with Huang, after which the board was satisfied with his "candor and ability to lead" the firm.

In reaching its decision, the board said it received input from "senior levels of the United States government," and based on that input, it is confident that Huang's reinstatement "poses no national security risk." The statement did not name the officials involved.

"The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers," board chair Harvey Jones said. Jones will remain chair, and Colette Kress, who served as interim CEO, continues as chief financial officer.

"I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment," Huang said in the statement. "I can't wait to get back to work."

The decision overturns the board's position from last week. "The Nvidia board does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO," Jones said on the company's November 17 earnings call, as Nvidia hired executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles to find a permanent replacement.

Hours earlier, Huang had offered to return if the board decided it was in the best interest of shareholders, employees, the company "and America." His comeback had drawn support from President Donald Trump and Elon Musk, even as CNBC reported that directors were not considering it.

Huang resigned on November 12 after reports of extramarital relationships, including one with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Nvidia customer Megaspeed whom U.S. officials suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset. China has denied that she is a spy.

The independent directors' committee investigating whether Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort "will proceed to conclusion," Nvidia said, and Huang has said he will cooperate with it.

The company also pointed to its new National Security and Export Control Committee, made up of independent directors, and said it is searching for a chief compliance officer to oversee compliance across the company. Nvidia said it will keep cooperating with government investigations and inquiries.

Congress Summons Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Lutnick Over Chip Exports to China

Huang still faces scrutiny in Washington. House committees have asked him to sit for a closed-door interview on December 1, and Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott (R-SC) has asked him to testify at a public hearing on December 3.

Nvidia shares rose to over $160 in premarket trading on Monday, up about 28% from Friday's close of $125.53, according to Yahoo! Finance. That would add roughly $780 billion to the company's market value, but still leave the stock below its $166.19 close on the day Huang resigned.

该公司周一表示，董事会一致投票决定恢复黄先生的总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员职务，立即生效。随后，董事会与黄进行了“一系列讨论和会议”，之后董事会对他“坦率和领导公司的能力”感到满意。

该委员会在做出决定时表示，它收到了“美国政府高层”的意见，并根据这些意见，相信黄的复职“不会构成国家安全风险”。声明没有透露相关官员的名字。

董事会主席 Harvey Jones 表示：“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 NVIDIA 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益。”琼斯将继续担任董事长，担任临时首席执行官的科莱特·克雷斯将继续担任首席财务官。

黄在声明中表示：“我以最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担起这一责任。” “我等不及要回去工作了。”

该决定推翻了董事会上周的立场。琼斯在公司 11 月 17 日的财报电话会议上表示，“Nvidia 董事会不打算恢复 Jensen 的首席执行官职务”，当时 Nvidia 聘请了猎头公司 Heidrick & Struggles 来寻找永久替代者。

几个小时前，黄先生提出，如果董事会认为这符合股东、员工、公司“和美国”的最佳利益，他就会重返公司。他的复出得到了唐纳德·特朗普总统和埃隆·马斯克的支持，尽管 CNBC 报道称董事们并未考虑此事。

英伟达表示，独立董事委员会调查黄是否是外国情报活动的目标“将得出结论”，黄也表示将配合该委员会。

该公司还提到了由独立董事组成的新的国家安全和出口管制委员会，并表示正在寻找一名首席合规官来监督整个公司的合规情况。英伟达表示将继续配合政府的调查和询问。

author: Stevie Bonifield
article_content:
It sure looked like President Donald Trump played a role in Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia CEO — and now the White House is making sure everyone knows he was. “President Trump was totally involved and this is a great decision by the NVIDIA board,” White House communications director Steven Cheung said in a statement, which was first reported by Semafor. “We have to protect our geniuses.”

Trump later went on CNBC with a similar statement. “We have to protect our geniuses,” he said on the air. Trump said he “believed very strongly” that Huang should be reinstated. “We’ve done a very thorough investigation, and the investigation showed that he did– I mean, he had bad judgement having to do with somewhat unrelated incidents. But he did nothing wrong.”

Trump also said, “If I didn’t get involved, you’d probably have a very sad Nvidia for a long time to come.”

Nvidia said in its announcement that its board “received input from senior levels of the United States government” that made them confident reinstating Huang would not pose a national security risk, following reports about his involvement with an alleged Chinese spy.

Trump also posted on Truth Social that Nvidia’s board “made the correct and proper decision” to reinstate Huang, adding:

Less than 12 hours earlier, Trump said in a separate post that Huang’s reinstatement “would be the best thing” for Nvidia and the US, and urged the board to rehire him. Reporting from Semafor now says that he was calling into Nvidia’s board meeting around this time to make the same argument.

title: US lawmakers criticize Nvidia decision to reinstate Huang as CEO
title_en: US lawmakers criticize Nvidia decision to reinstate Huang as CEO

inline_images.caption: US lawmakers criticize Nvidia decision to reinstate Huang as CEO (Photo: REUTERS)
inline_images.caption_en: US lawmakers criticize Nvidia decision to reinstate Huang as CEO (Photo: REUTERS)

author: Reuters
article_content:
WASHINGTON, Nov 23 (Reuters) - US lawmakers from both parties offered sharp criticism on Monday of Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and said Congress must pass legislation to crack down on US chip exports to China and get answers.

Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren, who is set to chair the Banking Committee starting in January, called the decision to reinstate Huang "reckless," adding the board still owes Congress answers about the company's compliance with US export controls.

"Jensen Huang's return only increases the urgency of passing bipartisan export control bills into law and making sure Nvidia does not lobby to kill that legislation and put our national security at risk," Warren said.

Nvidia did not immediately comment.

President Donald Trump on CNBC said he had pressed the Nvidia board to reinstate Huang and said he did not think the board would have acted without his action.

Last week, Huang agreed to testify before the US Senate in a public hearing, an aide to Republican US Senator Tim Scott said, as lawmakers probe allegations about Huang's ties to a woman accused of being a Chinese spy.

Representative Don Bacon, a Republican, said, "Huang was compromised and exploited by a Chinese spy. Nvidia should have moved on without Huang and ignored the administration's inexplicable desire to save Huang. Congress needs to get to the bottom of who approved high-end computer chips sales to China."

Huang separately agreed to a closed-door interview with three House committees, slated for December 1.

Democratic Representative Debbie Dingell said the Nvidia board "made an irresponsible decision to reinstate Jensen Huang before Congress has even heard from him."

She added, "There are serious national security questions that still need to be answered. The board must explain why it was willing to move ahead without those answers."

Republican Senator John Cornyn also questioned the board's determination. "No national security risk? Based on what?" Cornyn said on X.

Democratic Representative Richard Neal noted the Nvidia board cited "input from senior levels of the United States government" and said "this is one of the many reasons Congress needs to get answers on what exactly is going on here."

Illinois Governor JB Pritzker, a potential Democratic presidential candidate, also criticized the decision. "This is the greed and lack of accountability that the country just rejected," Pritzker said.

article_content_zh:
路透华盛顿11月23日 - 美国两党议员周一对英伟达恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官的决定提出了尖锐批评，并表示国会必须通过立法打击美国对华芯片出口并寻求答案。

民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 将于 1 月份开始担任银行委员会主席，她称恢复黄的决定是“鲁莽的”，并补充说董事会仍欠国会就该公司遵守美国出口管制的情况做出答复。

沃伦说：“黄仁勋的回归只会增加将两党出口管制法案通过为法律的紧迫性，并确保英伟达不会游说废除该立法并使我们的国家安全面临风险。”

英伟达没有立即发表评论。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在 CNBC 上表示，他已向英伟达董事会施压，要求其恢复黄仁勋的职位，并表示，如果他不采取行动，董事会不会采取行动。

美国共和党参议员蒂姆·斯科特的助手表示，上周，黄同意在美国参议院的公开听证会上作证，当时立法者正在调查有关黄与一名被指控为中国间谍的女性的关系的指控。

共和党众议员唐·培根 (Don Bacon) 表示，“黄被中国间谍妥协和利用。英伟达应该在没有黄的情况下继续前进，而无视政府拯救黄的莫名其妙的愿望。国会需要查清楚是谁批准向中国销售高端计算机芯片的。”

黄分别同意于 12 月 1 日接受众议院三个委员会的闭门采访。

民主党众议员黛比·丁格尔 (Debbie Dingell) 表示，英伟达董事会“在国会尚未收到黄仁勋的消息之前就恢复黄仁勋的职位，这是一个不负责任的决定”。

她补充说，“还有一些严重的国家安全问题需要回答。董事会必须解释为什么在没有这些答案的情况下愿意继续前进。”

共和党参议员约翰·科宁也对董事会的决定提出质疑。 “没有国家安全风险？基于什么？”科宁在 X 上说道。

民主党代表理查德·尼尔指出，英伟达董事会引用了“美国政府高层的意见”，并表示“这是国会需要获得有关到底发生了什么的答案的众多原因之一。”

潜在的民主党总统候选人、伊利诺伊州州长 JB Pritzker 也批评了这一决定。普利茨克说：“这个国家刚刚拒绝了这种贪婪和缺乏责任感。”

title: Tech leaders are celebrating Jensen Huang’s return
title_en: Tech leaders are celebrating Jensen Huang’s return
author: Gaby Del Valle
article_content:
Let’s say you’re Jensen Huang. You (allegedly) cheated on your wife with an alleged Chinese spy, allegedly had an affair with not one, but two subordinates, and (allegedly!) “terrorized” your employees, a series of indiscretions that led to your ouster from what was once the world’s most valuable company. (The stock price has recently taken a tumble, for obvious reasons.) And now you’re back, baby — and all your friends are so eager to congratulate you.

Elon Musk, for one, is thrilled.

And why wouldn’t he be? As a fellow leather jacket enthusiast who has a checkered history with women — including those who work for him — it’s clear that he and Huang have a lot in common beyond their positions as tech CEOs. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, too, is a man who can relate to Huang’s struggle.

Gavin Baker, founder and chief investment officer of Atreides, is so impressed by Huang’s rise from the ashes that he’s going to buy a leather jacket of his own.

Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeny chimed in with an oblique reference to Huang’s outerwear.

And then there’s billionaire investor Bill Ackman, a real wife guy if there ever was one — but one who, for better or worse, seems to understand that the market comes first.

Of course, no one has been more effusive than the man who may have orchestrated it all. President Donald Trump posted his lengthy congratulations to Huang on Truth Social. “I have gotten to know Jensen, and he is a Great Patriot and National Treasure,” Trump wrote. He commended Nvidia’s board for making the “correct and proper” decision in reinstating Huang — a decision that, the board admits, was made with input “from senior levels of the United States government,” who determined that “Huang’s reinstatement poses no security risk.” Isn’t that great news?

Trump expects Huang to make him proud. “I think you’re going to see some tremendous numbers out of this company,” Trump said on CNBC. “I talked to him last night. I said, ‘Jensen, just promise me one thing: You’re going to work hard.’ I spoke to him last night because I knew what was going on.”

The market’s reaction may be the most jubilant of all. Per Odd Lots host Joe Weisenthal, NASDAQ-100 futures jumped so quickly that trading was halted. Congratulations to everyone who bought the dip, I guess.

(The stock price has recently taken a tumble, for obvious reasons.) And now you’re back, baby — and all your friends are so eager to congratulate you.

article_content_zh:
假设你是黄仁勋。你（据称）与一名所谓的中国间谍欺骗了你的妻子，据称与不是一个人而是两名下属有染，并且（据称！）“恐吓”了你的员工，一系列轻率行为导致你被这家曾经是世界上最有价值的公司驱逐。 （由于显而易见的原因，股价最近暴跌。）现在你回来了，宝贝——你所有的朋友都非常渴望祝贺你。

埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）就是其中之一，他很兴奋。

他为什么不呢？作为一名皮夹克爱好者，与女性（包括那些为他工作的女性）有着一段曲折的历史，很明显，他和黄除了担任科技首席执行官之外还有很多共同点。 OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 也对黄仁勋的挣扎感同身受。

Atreides 创始人兼首席投资官加文·贝克 (Gavin Baker) 对黄的浴火重生印象深刻，打算购买一件属于自己的皮夹克。

Epic Games 首席执行官 Tim Sweeny 也间接提到了黄的外套。

还有亿万富翁投资者比尔·阿克曼（Bill Ackman），如果有的话，他是一个真正的贤妻良母——但无论好坏，他似乎都明白市场是第一位的。

当然，没有人比策划这一切的人更热情了。唐纳德·特朗普总统在 Truth Social 上向黄致以漫长的祝贺。特朗普写道：“我认识了詹森，他是一位伟大的爱国者和国宝。”他赞扬英伟达董事会做出了“正确且恰当”的恢复黄的决定——董事会承认，这一决定是在“美国政府高层”的意见下做出的，他们认为“黄的恢复不会带来安全风险”。这不是个好消息吗？

特朗普希望黄让他感到自豪。特朗普在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“我认为你会从这家公司看到一些巨大的数字。” “我昨晚和他谈过。我说，‘詹森，只要答应我一件事：你会努力工作。’我昨晚和他谈过，因为我知道发生了什么事。”

市场的反应可能是最令人高兴的。根据 Odd Lot 主持人 Joe Weisenthal 的说法，纳斯达克 100 期货价格上涨如此之快，以至于交易被暂停。我想，恭喜所有购买此股的人。

title: Trump tells CNBC he spoke to Nvidia board directly about Jensen Huang
title_en: Trump tells CNBC he spoke to Nvidia board directly about Jensen Huang
author: Dan Mangan
article_content:
President Donald Trump told CNBC on Monday morning that newly restored Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang "did nothing wrong."

Trump also told CNBC's Eamon Javers that "I think the [Nvidia] board acted really responsibly"in deciding to reinstate Huang.

"They did ask for assurance on the national security threat,"Trump said in a phone interview.

"And we gave him assurance at least with everything we know, and we know a lot,"Trump said.

Trump said he spoke with Huang on Sunday night, before Nvdia's board announced his reinstatement.

"I'm very, very happy that the company had the courage and the board had the courage to do the right thing, and they suffered for two weeks, and the company suffered greatly,"the president said.

Asked if the fact that stocks broadly fell last week in the wake of Huang's resignation from Nvidia factored into his decision to push for the CEO's reinstatement, Trump said, "Probably so, but the bigger impact was the long term."

"The bigger impact was, you know, he's got other chips in his brain that nobody else knows about,"Trump said.

title: Exclusive: Hours before Huang’s reinstatement, Trump called Nvidia’s board to argue for his return
title_en: Exclusive: Hours before Huang’s reinstatement, Trump called Nvidia’s board to argue for his return
author: Rohan Goswami and Shelby Talcott
article_content:
US President Donald Trump had dialed into Nvidia’s board meeting to argue for Jensen Huang’s return, hours before the company reinstated the ousted CEO, according to people familiar with the matter.

Nvidia’s board on Monday reinstated Huang, saying the company had received assurances from “senior levels of the United States government” that he posed no national security risk after carrying on an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

“President Trump was totally involved and this is a great decision by the NVIDIA board. We have to protect our geniuses,” White House communications director Steven Cheung said.

Nvidia’s board met late last night, according to a person familiar with the matter, and voted unanimously. Huang’s resignation spurred an outcry from some Silicon Valley figures who called for his return. Semafor had previously reported that a faction of directors had continued to push for him to come back.

The anti-Jensen camp was dealt a blow when they learned a leading Huang replacement candidate, Arm CEO Rene Haas, had signed a new contract with Arm extending his employment until 2033, according to another person familiar with some directors’ thinking.

“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,” Harvey Jones, who was elevated at the time of Huang’s Nov. 12 ouster to board chairman, said in a statement.

The decision comes less than two weeks after Huang stepped down under pressure, and returns Huang to the company he founded in 1993 and built into an AI giant. Huang has also been accused of having an affair with a subordinate.

Nvidia’s stock was up nearly 30% in early trading Monday, the biggest jump in more than two decades.

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在英伟达董事会会议上呼吁黄仁勋的回归，而就在该公司恢复被罢免的首席执行官的几小时前。

英伟达董事会周一恢复了黄仁勋的职务，称该公司已得到“美国政府高层”的保证，称黄仁勋在与一名涉嫌中国间谍发生关系后不会构成国家安全风险。

“特朗普总统完全参与其中，这是 NVIDIA 董事会的一个伟大决定。我们必须保护我们的天才，”白宫通讯总监史蒂文·张 (Steven Cheung) 表示。

据一位知情人士透露，英伟达董事会昨晚深夜召开会议，并一致投票。黄的辞职引发了一些硅谷人士的强烈抗议，要求他回归。 Semafor 此前曾报道称，一派董事继续推动他回归。

据另一位熟悉部分董事想法的人士透露，当反詹森阵营得知黄的主要继任者候选人、Arm 首席执行官雷内·哈斯 (Rene Haas) 已与 Arm 签署了一份新合同，将其任期延长至 2033 年时，他们受到了打击。

“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 NVIDIA 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益，”在黄仁勋 11 月 12 日被罢免时被提升为董事会主席的哈维·琼斯 (Harvey Jones) 在一份声明中表示。

这一决定是在黄仁勋迫于压力辞职后不到两周做出的，黄仁勋回到了他于 1993 年创立的公司，并将其打造成一家人工智能巨头。黄还被指控与下属有染。

周一早盘，英伟达股价上涨近 30%，创二十多年来最大涨幅。

title_en: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model

author: Jonathan Kemper
article_content:
Z.ai is moving its flagship model to a loop architecture that runs some of its layers twice. With GLM-5.4, the company wants to mark the start of "Generalized Coding,"where code also generates videos, games, and CAD models.

Following OpenAI, Z.ai is introducing GLM-5.4, its first large model built on a loop transformer. While standard language models use each layer once per pass, GLM-5.4 runs a block of shared layers multiple times, refining the intermediate results from the previous pass to make the network deeper without adding parameters. OpenAI has used a similar architecture since GPT-6 Astra. According to Z.ai, the 750-billion-parameter model reaches performance comparable to models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters.

The team retrained the GLM-5 base model released in February into a loop model that runs 28 layers twice. Loop models trained from scratch have so far performed worse than models without shared weights under the same compute budget, Z.ai writes.

### Gates and shared caching keep the second pass manageable

Converting the model introduces a problem, Z.ai says. If the model simply overwrites intermediate states on each pass, activations grow sharply from round to round, leaving subsequent layers with values outside the range they were trained on.

To handle this, GLM-5.4 uses dedicated gates for each token and pass to control how much of the new output flows back into the data stream. According to Z.ai, the model builds context cautiously on the first pass and writes its changes back in full on the second. On difficult tokens, Z.ai says, the first pass steps in more strongly.

Because the second pass would otherwise double memory usage, both passes share the KV cache, the temporary memory for previously processed tokens. The second pass stores its own extra values only in a small local window. As a result, Z.ai says, the overhead compared to GLM-5.3 stays manageable even at a 1-million-token context.

To save on compute as well, the model uses sparse attention to pick the most relevant earlier tokens upfront rather than scanning the entire context every time, a standard technique. The second pass then reuses that selection from the first instead of making a new one. According to Z.ai, that yields nearly the same results as picking tokens separately on each pass. The company also says the model reaches up to 200 tokens per second off-peak and 70 to 80 tokens per second under load.

### A looped 30B test model beats its baseline with shorter reasoning chains

Before rolling out the architecture in its flagship, Z.ai tested it on models with 1, 4, 30, and 750 billion parameters. For a direct comparison, the team used a 30B model built on the same architecture as the large base model. Both versions had the same parameter count, while the loop version received about 10 percent more training compute. Its biggest gain came on the AIME25 math benchmark, where scores jumped from 19.2 to 30.4 points. Scores on the expert-level science questions in GPQA-Diamond rose from 47.6 to 56.3 points, and on the AA-LCR long-context test they climbed from 40.3 to 47.7 points. Gains were smaller at just over three points on the MMLU-Pro knowledge test and on IFBench, which tests instruction following.

Responses also got shorter, shrinking 14.9 percent on MMLU-Pro, 11.7 percent on GPQA-Diamond, and just 2 percent on AIME25. Z.ai says part of the reasoning shifts out of the output tokens and into the loop's extra computational depth.

It is still impossible to judge how well GLM-5.4 actually performs, as Z.ai has published no benchmark scores for the 750B model and the figures in its blog post come solely from the 30B test. There are no independent evaluations from groups like Artificial Analysis either.

By Z.ai's own account, GLM-5.4's biggest weakness is overly long reasoning phases in which the model gets stuck, though the company says that extended double-checking improves accuracy.

Z.ai views GLM-5.4 as the starting point for "Generalized Coding,"where the company says code becomes the foundation for tasks beyond traditional software development. To illustrate the idea, Z.ai shows a music video scored by the model itself, a six-axis robot arm it says GLM-5.4 designed in FreeCAD, a complete game, and an interactive 3D scene built from mathematical geometry and custom shaders.

### Z.ai plans to release model weights and a much larger model

GLM-5.4 is available through the GLM Coding Plan, the ZCode coding environment, and Z.ai Chat, with an API set to follow and token pricing not yet announced. Z.ai plans to release the model weights after further safety testing, and it also announced a much larger model expected to arrive soon.

Shared layers date back to the Universal Transformer in 2018. In March, researchers in Bonn showed that looped transformers benefit from greater compute depth on math, while everyday knowledge benefits more from greater memory, the same trade-off Z.ai cites to explain its architecture. Thinking Machines also drew attention recently with Inkling 2 Mini because the loop model runs locally on Macs with at least 32 GB of RAM.

At 750 billion parameters, GLM-5.4 is nowhere near running on a laptop, but Z.ai is instead targeting the tier of Kimi K3.1 Pro and Qwen3.8-Max. At 2.8 trillion and 2.4 trillion parameters, respectively, those models are more than three times as large and require large amounts of compute.

For its predecessor GLM-5.3, Z.ai kept the existing base model and drew all of its gains from post-training. The company delayed releasing its weights because of the model's strong vulnerability-finding abilities, and Anthropic later found that GLM-5.3 could build exploits on its own, almost on par with Claude Mythos Preview.

article_content_zh:
Z.ai 正在将其旗舰模型转向循环架构，该架构的某些层运行两次。该公司希望通过 GLM-5.4 标志着“通用编码”的开始，其中代码还可以生成视频、游戏和 CAD 模型。

继 OpenAI 之后，Z.ai 推出了 GLM-5.4，这是其第一个基于环形变压器构建的大型模型。标准语言模型每次传递使用每个层一次，而 GLM-5.4 多次运行共享层块，细化前一传递的中间结果，使网络更深，而无需添加参数。自 GPT-6 Astra 以来，OpenAI 就使用了类似的架构。 Z.ai 表示，7500 亿参数模型的性能可与 2 至 3 万亿参数模型相媲美。

该团队将 2 月份发布的 GLM-5 基础模型重新训练为运行 28 层两次的循环模型。 Z.ai 写道，到目前为止，在相同计算预算下，从头开始训练的循环模型的表现比没有共享权重的模型要差。

### 门和共享缓存使第二遍易于管理

Z.ai 说，转换模型会带来一个问题。如果模型简单地覆盖每次传递的中间状态，则激活从一轮到另一轮急剧增长，使后续层的值超出其训练范围。

为了处理这个问题，GLM-5.4 对每个令牌使用专用门，并通过控制有多少新输出流回数据流。根据 Z.ai 的说法，该模型在第一次传递时谨慎地构建上下文，并在第二次传递时完整写回其更改。 Z.ai 说，对于困难的标记，第一遍的作用会更强。

因为第二遍会使内存使用量加倍，所以两次遍共享 KV 缓存，即先前处理的令牌的临时内存。第二遍仅将其自己的额外值存储在一个小的本地窗口中。 Z.ai 表示，因此，即使在 100 万代币的环境下，与 GLM-5.3 相比，开销仍然是可控的。

为了节省计算量，该模型使用稀疏注意力来预先选择最相关的早期标记，而不是每次都扫描整个上下文，这是一种标准技术。然后，第二遍重用第一遍的选择，而不是创建新的选择。根据 Z.ai 的说法，这与在每次传递中分别挑选令牌产生的结果几乎相同。该公司还表示，该模型在非高峰时段每秒可处理高达 200 个令牌，在负载下每秒可处理 70 至 80 个令牌。

### 循环 30B 测试模型以更短的推理链击败了其基线

在其旗舰产品中推出该架构之前，Z.ai 在具有 1、4、30 和 7500 亿个参数的模型上对其进行了测试。为了进行直接比较，该团队使用了与大型基础模型基于相同架构构建的 30B 模型。两个版本具有相同的参数数量，而循环版本接收的训练计算量增加了约 10%。其最大的进步来自 AIME25 数学基准，分数从 19.2 跃升至 30.4 分。 GPQA-Diamond 专家级科学问题的分数从 47.6 分上升到 56.3 分，AA-LCR 长上下文测试的分数从 40.3 分上升到 47.7 分。在 MMLU-Pro 知识测试和测试指令遵循的 IFBench 上，收益较小，仅超过三个点。

响应也变得更短，MMLU-Pro 上的响应缩短了 14.9%，GPQA-Diamond 上缩短了 11.7%，AIME25 上仅缩短了 2%。 Z.ai 表示，部分推理从输出标记转移到循环的额外计算深度中。

目前还无法判断 GLM-5.4 的实际表现如何，因为 Z.ai 尚未发布 750B 型号的基准分数，并且其博客文章中的数据仅来自 30B 测试。人工分析等组织也没有独立评估。

根据 Z.ai 自己的说法，GLM-5.4 最大的弱点是推理阶段过长，模型会陷入困境，尽管该公司表示，扩展的双重检查可以提高准确性。

Z.ai 将 GLM-5.4 视为“通用编码”的起点，该公司表示，代码成为传统软件开发之外的任务的基础。为了说明这个想法，Z.ai 展示了一个由模型本身评分的音乐视频、一个用 FreeCAD 设计的六轴机器人手臂 GLM-5.4、一个完整的游戏，以及一个由数学几何和自定义着色器构建的交互式 3D 场景。

author: Bloomberg
article_content:
Amazon is reportedly closer to a $7.5 billion deal to acquire artificial intelligence startup Decart.

That’s according to a report Saturday (Nov. 21) by the Financial Times (FT), citing sources familiar with the matter. The report notes that the purchase of Decart, whose software allows AI models to function more efficiently and free up computer chip capacity, helps Amazon Web Services compete with Nvidia.

The sources said the negotiations were at an advanced stage for a deal valuing Decart at roughly $7.5 billion. A deal could come together in the coming days, though talks could still fall apart, the sources added.

The FT noted that Amazon debuted its Trainium3 AI chip late last year to compete with Nvidia’s widely used graphics processing units. Decart was an early adopter of those chips.

Decart was also reported as a potential acquisition target for Anthropic earlier this year, before that company walked away from the deal.

The Wall Street Journal reported on Amazon’s interest in Decart in October. A spokesperson for Amazon declined to comment when reached by PYMNTS.

This deal is happening as American tech stocks have fallen into “bear market territory,” the FT report added, logging their worst week since the COVID pandemic due to worries that the AI investment boom had begun to cool.

In other AI news, recent PYMNTS Intelligence research shows consumers using the technology for money management in a variety of ways.

“They can ask an AI assistant to compare financial products, explain annual fees, look up the meaning of an unfamiliar rate or help draft a message questioning a charge,” PYMNTS wrote in the report “Consumers Ask AI Twice: Which Card and Why the Fee?”

“Of those specific tasks, comparing financial products had the broadest reach across generations,” the report added. “Even among baby boomers and seniors who used generative AI (Gen AI) in their personal lives, roughly one in eight used it to compare financial products, while just three in 100 used it to draft a dispute or support message.”

The research found that 22.5% of consumers surveyed in September of this year had used Gen AI for money management at least once in the last 12 months, a figure little changed from a year earlier. What distinguished consumers was the extent to which they were using AI already, with close to 80% of power users turning to it for money management, and more than half using it for specific needs like crafting a budget.

article_content_zh:
亚马逊即将以 75 亿美元收购人工智能初创公司 Decart。

这是英国《金融时报》(FT) 周六（11 月 21 日）援引知情人士的话报道称。报告指出，收购 Decart 有助于亚马逊网络服务与 Nvidia 竞争，Decart 的软件可以让人工智能模型更有效地运行并释放计算机芯片容量。

消息人士称，Decart 估值约为 75 亿美元的交易谈判已进入后期阶段。消息人士补充说，尽管谈判仍可能破裂，但未来几天可能会达成协议。

英国《金融时报》指出，亚马逊去年年底推出了 Trainium3 人工智能芯片，以与 Nvidia 广泛使用的图形处理单元竞争。 Decart 是这些芯片的早期采用者。

今年早些时候，Decart 也被报道为 Anthropic 的潜在收购目标，但该公司后来放弃了交易。

《华尔街日报》十月份报道了亚马逊对 Decart 的兴趣。 PYMNTS 联系到亚马逊发言人时，拒绝置评。

英国《金融时报》报道补充称，这笔交易发生之际，美国科技股已跌入“熊市区域”，由于担心人工智能投资热潮已开始降温，美国科技股创下了自新冠疫情大流行以来最糟糕的一周。

在其他人工智能新闻中，PYMNTS Intelligence 最近的研究表明，消费者以多种方式使用该技术进行资金管理。

PYMNTS 在报告《消费者问人工智能两次：哪张卡和为什么收费？》中写道：“他们可以要求人工智能助手比较金融产品、解释年费、查找不熟悉的费率的含义或帮助起草质疑收费的消息。”

报告补充说：“在这些具体任务中，比较金融产品在各代人中影响最广泛。” “即使在个人生活中使用生成式人工智能 (Gen AI) 的婴儿潮一代和老年人中，大约八分之一的人用它来比较金融产品，而只有十分之三的人用它来起草争议或支持信息。”

研究发现，今年 9 月接受调查的消费者中有 22.5% 在过去 12 个月内至少使用过一次 Gen AI 进行资金管理，这一数字与去年同期相比变化不大。消费者的独特之处在于他们使用人工智能的程度，近 80% 的高级用户将其用于资金管理，超过一半的用户将其用于制定预算等特定需求。

title: Chinese military fears AI could let the US find and destroy its nuclear missiles
title_en: Chinese military fears AI could let the US find and destroy its nuclear missiles
author: Maximilian Schreiner
article_content:
Chinese military researchers fear that AI advances could give the US an edge in the nuclear balance of power. Experts in China worry that artificial intelligence could make it easier for US forces to detect and destroy Chinese nuclear missiles, according to a New York Times analysis. That would undermine China's deterrence strategy, which relies on a guaranteed second-strike capability.

Researchers at the Academy of Military Sciences in Beijing write that AI could shrink US decision-making time from 15 to 30 minutes down to 90 seconds. China currently has about 620 operational warheads, according to the Federation of American Scientists, and is expected to expand its arsenal to roughly 1,000 by 2030. At the same time, Chinese military institutes are studying how AI could make their own weapons harder to intercept, for instance by using AI-controlled flight paths for hypersonic missiles.

Experts warn, however, that flawed AI data could trigger dangerous miscalculations during a crisis. That risk proved very real earlier this year, when the US military nearly boarded a Chinese ship based on a false, AI-generated intelligence report. Xi Jinping did discuss nuclear risks at a summit with Trump and Putin, but AI's role in nuclear weapons never came up, according to the report. Despite the growing urgency, the US and China have made almost no progress on talks about AI safeguards in nuclear systems.

title: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
title_en: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
author: Caroline Haskins
article_content:
Jensen Huang is stepping back into his role as chief executive of Nvidia effective immediately.

The stunning reversal comes 11 days after Huang resigned as CEO from the company he cofounded 33 years ago, and after multiple declarations from the board of directors that it had no intention of reinstating him. On Monday, they took a conciliatory tone.

“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers,” said recently appointed board chair Harvey Jones in a press release announcing the decision.

In that announcement the board said it was “satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia,” and that it had “received input from senior levels of the United States government” on the way to its decision. On Monday morning, President Donald Trump posted that the Nvidia board “has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO.”

“I am honored to return to Nvidia and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” said Huang in a statement. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment.”

Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO on November 12, and longtime chief financial officer Colette Kress was installed as his interim replacement. Five days later, Huang publicly announced that he was open to resuming his role as chief executive, noting the “outpouring of calls” from “employees, investors, business partners, and customers” advocating for his return.

“If the board of directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO,” Huang wrote.

The day Huang resigned, many Nvidia employees spoke up in his support. As reported by WIRED, employees left more than 1,600 comments on an internal “suggestion box” post in which they urged the company’s board to reinstall him as CEO.

In the days following, a public petition calling for Huang’s reinstatement began circulating. At the time of writing, it has amassed more than 200,000 online signatures, the majority of whom self-identified as Nvidia shareholders. Tech elites like Elon Musk and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan have claimed that they were going to sign the petition or had signed it.

Huang’s reinstatement marks a total reversal from the public stance of Nvidia’s board of directors, which said during the company’s November 17 earnings call that it “does not intend” to reinstate him as CEO. WIRED has further reported that the board was alarmed by what one source described as Huang’s “lying” over the last year or so.

President Donald Trump, who developed a close working relationship with Huang during his second administration, had indicated openness to Huang returning as CEO. Trump told reporters on November 16 that he “would not mind” if Huang returned as chief executive, adding that he believed he had “learned a big lesson.”

Huang’s resignation followed days of scrutiny over several extramarital romantic relationships: one with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who has no known relation to Jensen, one with a Nvidia employee who directly reported to Huang, and one with a different Nvidia employee.

Huang’s relationship with Alice became the subject of particularly intense focus on November 6, when The New York Times and Financial Times reported that US intelligence officials suspected that Alice may be an asset of the Chinese Ministry of State Security, both citing an intelligence briefing that circulated among top Trump administration officials last year. In the days since, some reports and Trump administration officials have questioned the accuracy of that intelligence. The Chinese government has consistently rejected claims that Alice was one of its spies.

Alice was the chief executive of Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI company that’s been accused of helping Chinese tech companies use Nvidia’s most advanced chips at overseas locations, effectively sidestepping US export restrictions. Alice has also reportedly worked as a television reporter, at HSBC's Hong Kong-based private banking arm, and at an investment bank backed by the Chinese state.

Huang cofounded Nvidia in 1993 with Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem, purportedly with the mission of bringing realistic 3D graphics to personal computers. For many years, the company was primarily known within the gaming community. It didn’t become a household name until the recent AI boom, when its graphic processing units (GPUs) became a crucial piece of infrastructure for powering advanced AI models.

Nvidia controlled about 90 percent of the global GPU market as of September 2026. The year prior, it became the first ever company to be valued at more than $4 trillion, though its stock price has been in precipitous decline since Huang’s resignation.

key_points_en: Key Development: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO

article_content_zh:
黄仁勋将重新担任英伟达首席执行官，立即生效。

这一惊人的逆转发生在黄仁勋从他 33 年前共同创立的公司辞去首席执行官职务 11 天后，董事会多次声明无意恢复他的职位。周一，他们采取了和解的语气。

“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 Nvidia 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益，”最近任命的董事会主席 Harvey Jones 在宣布这一决定的新闻稿中表示。

董事会在公告中表示，“对黄先生领导英伟达的坦率和能力感到满意”，并且在做出决定时“收到了美国政府高层的意见”。周一早上，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 表示，英伟达董事会“已做出正确且适当的决定，让黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官”。

黄仁勋在一份声明中表示：“我很荣幸回到英伟达，并在新工业革命开始之际领导世界上最有影响力的科技公司之一。” “我以最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担这一责任。”

黄仁勋于 11 月 12 日辞去 Nvidia 首席执行官职务，长期担任首席财务官的科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 被任命为临时继任者。五天后，黄仁勋公开宣布，他对恢复首席执行官一职持开放态度，并指出“员工、投资者、商业伙伴和客户”纷纷发出“大量电话”，要求他回归。

黄写道：“如果董事会认为我的回归符合我们股东、员工、公司和美国的最佳利益，我将很荣幸回应这些呼吁并重新担任首席执行官。”

黄仁勋辞职当天，许多英伟达员工纷纷发声支持他。据《连线》报道，员工在内部“意见箱”帖子中留下了 1,600 多条评论，敦促公司董事会重新任命他为首席执行官。

接下来的几天里，要求黄先生复职的公众请愿书开始流传。截至撰写本文时，它已收集了超过 20 万个在线签名，其中大多数自称是 Nvidia 股东。埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和 Y Combinator 首席执行官加里·谭 (Garry Tan) 等科技精英声称他们将签署请愿书或已经签署了请愿书。

黄仁勋的复职标志着英伟达董事会公开立场的彻底逆转，该公司董事会在 11 月 17 日的财报电话会议上表示，“不打算”恢复他的首席执行官职务。 《连线》进一步报道称，一位消息人士称黄在过去一年左右的时间里“撒谎”，董事会对此感到震惊。

唐纳德·特朗普总统在第二届政府期间与黄仁勋建立了密切的工作关系，他曾表示对黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官持开放态度。特朗普11月16日对记者表示，如果黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官，他“不会介意”，并补充说，他相信自己“学到了一个重要的教训”。

黄的辞职是在数天对几起婚外恋关系进行审查之后提出的：其中一份与中国女商人爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）与詹森没有已知的关系，一份与一名直接向黄的 Nvidia 员工汇报，另一份与另一名 Nvidia 员工。

11 月 6 日，黄与爱丽丝的关系成为特别关注的话题，当时《纽约时报》和《金融时报》报道称，美国情报官员怀疑爱丽丝可能是中国国家安全部的资产，两者都援引了去年在特朗普政府高级官员中流传的一份情报简报。此后几天，一些报道和特朗普政府官员质疑该情报的准确性。中国政府一直否认爱丽丝是其间谍之一的说法。

爱丽丝是新加坡人工智能公司 Megaspeed 的首席执行官，该公司被指控帮助中国科技公司在海外使用英伟达最先进的芯片，从而有效地规避了美国的出口限制。据报道，爱丽丝还曾在汇丰银行驻香港的私人银行部门和一家由中国政府支持的投资银行担任电视记者。

title: Nvidia tried life without Jensen Huang and it lasted about two weeks
title_en: Nvidia tried life without Jensen Huang and it lasted about two weeks
author: Maximilian Schreiner
article_content:
Nvidia's board of directors has reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and board member, effective immediately. The decision was unanimous, Nvidia said in a press release, following talks with Huang and feedback from senior US government officials who concluded that his return poses no national security risk.

CFO Colette Kress had been running the company on an interim basis, and the stock had tanked during that period. President Donald J. Trump praised the decision on Truth Social, saying the US Attorney General found no evidence of wrongdoing by Huang. The move comes after reports that Huang had been targeted by foreign intelligence operations. An independent board committee is still investigating the matter with outside counsel.

The US government is also reviewing Nvidia's business dealings. Trump urged the company to keep looking into whether its export control compliance holds up. Nvidia has already set up a dedicated oversight committee for that purpose and is searching for a Chief Compliance Officer. Huang and the company said they'll continue cooperating with authorities and internal investigators. Nvidia's stock jumped more than 30 percent on the news.

title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive
title_en: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive

inline_images.alt: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive

author: Tim Bradshaw
article_content:
Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its chief executive in a stunning reversal of its position on the disgraced co-founder, sending the AI giant’s shares soaring more than 30 per cent in pre-market trading.

In a statement on Monday, Nvidia said its board had voted unanimously to reinstate Huang “following a series of discussions and meetings . . . after which the board was satisfied with respect to Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia”.

The Nvidia board said it received input from “senior levels” of the US government. “Based on that input, the board is confident that Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk,” the company added.

“The board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,” said Harvey Jones, chair of the board.

The company added that an investigation into Huang’s conduct was ongoing.

Until Monday, Nvidia’s stock had lost more than $2.5tn in value since its all-time high in October, before a series of revelations emerged about Huang’s affairs with at least one subordinate and with a client whom US intelligence suspects is a Chinese spy.

On Monday, Huang said he was “honoured to return to Nvidia”, which he co-founded 33 years ago. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment,” he said.

Despite the allegations against Huang and a series of state and federal investigations into Nvidia, US President Donald Trump has continued to stand by the AI company’s co-founder, saying he would like to see his friend and donor return as chief executive.

Trump said on Monday that Nvidia’s board made the “correct and proper decision” to return Huang to the role of CEO.

“The Country needs Jensen’s leadership at Nvidia in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy,” Trump wrote in a social media post following the board’s announcement.

He added that the US government “has no reason” to believe that Huang’s return poses any risk to national security, adding that it “does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct”.

Trump said he that he has “gotten to know Jensen” and described him as a “Great Patriot and National Treasure”, adding that Nvidia should continue its investigation of its compliance with US export controls.

On Sunday, US Treasury secretary Scott Bessent seemingly reversed his position on Huang’s reappointment, refusing to rule out such a move after previously calling on the company’s board to implement a “dramatic shake-up” and look “outside” for new leadership.

The abrupt turnaround comes less than a week after Jones had told investors on Nvidia’s quarterly earnings call that the board had “unanimously accepted [Huang’s] resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO”.

Several Silicon Valley investors and founders, including SpaceX and Tesla chief Elon Musk, investor Gavin Baker and former Uber chief Travis Kalanick, have pushed for Huang’s reinstatement. A petition to “bring Jensen back” has received more than 200,000 signatures, including from some Nvidia staff.

Nvidia shares opened 34 per cent higher on Monday morning, which, if sustained, would be the stock’s biggest one-day jump since March 2000.

Such a move would add about $1tn in market capitalisation, a record increase for any company, and follows a 14 per cent drop on Friday that wiped $492bn from the company’s valuation.

Huang thanked Nvidia’s board and Colette Kress, its finance chief who became interim CEO, as well as “employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support”.

“Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work,” he said.

article_content_zh:
Nvidia 恢复了黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的首席执行官职务，这与这位名誉扫地的联合创始人的地位发生了惊人的逆转，这使得这家人工智能巨头的股价在盘前交易中飙升了 30% 以上。

英伟达在周一的一份声明中表示，“经过一系列讨论和会议……董事会对黄仁勋的坦率和领导英伟达的能力感到满意”，董事会一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋的职位。

英伟达董事会表示，它收到了美国政府“高层”的意见。该公司补充说：“根据这一意见，董事会相信黄的复职不会构成国家安全风险。”

董事会主席 Harvey Jones 表示：“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 Nvidia 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益。”

该公司补充说，对黄的行为的调查正在进行中。

直到周一，英伟达的股价自 10 月份创下的历史高点以来已经下跌了 2.5 万亿美元以上，随后一系列有关黄与至少一名下属以及美国情报部门怀疑是中国间谍的客户的风流韵事的消息被曝光。

周一，黄仁勋表示，他“很荣幸重返 Nvidia”，该公司是他 33 年前与他人共同创立的。 “我以最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担这一责任，”他说。

尽管黄仁勋受到指控，并且州和联邦对英伟达进行了一系列调查，但美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍然支持这家人工智能公司的联合创始人，表示他希望看到他的朋友和捐助者重新担任首席执行官。

特朗普周一表示，英伟达董事会做出了“正确且恰当的决定”，让黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官。

“国家需要詹森在英伟达的领导，以确保公司和美国经济的成功和繁荣，”董事会宣布这一消息后，特朗普在社交媒体上发帖写道。

他补充说，美国政府“没有理由”相信黄的回国对国家安全构成任何风险，并补充说，美国政府“没有证据表明他从事任何非法行为”。

特朗普表示，他“认识了詹森”，并将他描述为“伟大的爱国者和国宝”，并补充说英伟达应该继续调查其遵守美国出口管制的情况。

周日，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特(Scott Bessent)似乎改变了对黄连任的立场，拒绝排除此举的可能性，此前他曾呼吁该公司董事会实施“大幅改组”，并“从外部”寻找新的领导层。

不到一周前，琼斯在英伟达季度财报电话会议上告诉投资者，董事会“一致接受（黄的）辞职，并且不打算恢复詹森担任首席执行官”。

title: Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia’s CEO
title_en: Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia’s CEO
author: Emma Roth
article_content:
Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO. The company announced on Monday morning that the board “voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead NVIDIA.”

In its statement, the board says that it received input “from senior levels of the United States government” and determined that “Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.” Donald Trump responded to the board’s decision in a post on Truth Social, saying Nvidia “made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO… The United States Government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security. The Attorney General of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. Government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct.”

The board’s statement says that its investigation into reports that Huang was the target of a Chinese spy plot will continue, with Huang’s support and cooperation, while interim CEO Colette Kress will continue as CFO, and Harvey Jones will remain as the recently appointed board chair.

“I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” Huang said in a statement. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment. I want to thank the NVIDIA Board for its confidence and deliberation through this process.” This move comes after Jones said during an earnings call last week that the Nvidia board “does not intend” to return Huang as CEO.

Huang resigned as CEO earlier this month following reports of extramarital affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and two Nvidia employees, including an executive who reported to him. In the wake of his departure, more than 200,000 people, including Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, and Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick, signed a letter to Nvidia’s board, calling for his reinstatement.

Nvidia shares tumbled in Huang’s absence, while industry analysts raised concerns about an outsider replacing him at a time when Nvidia is so critical to the AI boom. Nonetheless, the board maintained as recently as last Tuesday that Huang wasn’t coming back.

article_content_zh:
英伟达恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官。该公司周一上午宣布，董事会“在与黄先生进行一系列讨论和会议后，一致投票决定恢复黄先生的职务，之后董事会对黄先生的坦率和领导 NVIDIA 的能力感到满意。”

该委员会在声明中表示，它收到了“美国政府高层”的意见，并确定“黄的复职不会构成国家安全风险”。唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 在 Truth Social 上发帖回应了董事会的决定，称 Nvidia“做出了正确且恰当的决定，让黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 重返首席执行官职位……美国政府没有理由相信黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 重返 NVIDIA 会对国家安全构成任何风险。美国司法部长已确认，美国政府没有证据表明他曾从事任何非法行为。”

董事会声明称，在黄的支持和配合下，将继续对有关黄是中国间谍阴谋目标的报道进行调查，临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯将继续担任首席财务官，哈维·琼斯将继续担任最近任命的董事会主席。

黄仁勋在一份声明中表示：“我很荣幸能够回到 NVIDIA，并在新工业革命开始之际领导世界上最有影响力的科技公司之一。” “我以最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担起这一责任。我要感谢 NVIDIA 董事会在这一过程中的信任和深思熟虑。”在此之前，琼斯在上周的财报电话会议上表示，英伟达董事会“不打算”让黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官。

本月早些时候，黄仁勋辞去首席执行官一职，此前有报道称，黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍和两名英伟达员工（其中包括一名向他汇报的高管）有婚外情。在他离职后，包括特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克、Epic Games 首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼、Y Combinator 首席执行官加里·谭和 Uber 联合创始人特拉维斯·卡兰尼克在内的超过 20 万人签署了一封致英伟达董事会的信，呼吁让他复职。

黄仁勋缺席后，英伟达股价暴跌，而行业分析师对在英伟达对人工智能繁荣至关重要之际出现外部人士取代他表示担忧。尽管如此，董事会直到上周二仍坚称黄不会回来。

author: Nvidia Newsroom
article_content:
NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board. The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead NVIDIA. In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.

“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,” said Harvey C. Jones, Chair of the Board. “We have every confidence in Jensen and look forward to working with him as he resumes his leadership of the Company. We are grateful to Colette Kress for her outstanding service as interim CEO, in addition to her continuing responsibilities as NVIDIA’s Chief Financial Officer.” Harvey Jones will remain as Board chair.

“I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” said Jensen Huang. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment. I want to thank the NVIDIA Board for its confidence and deliberation through this process. I am especially grateful to Harvey Jones for his leadership as Chair, and to Colette Kress and our executive staff for leading NVIDIA during this period. I am also deeply thankful to our employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support. Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work.”

As previously announced, in light of recent reporting that Mr. Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort, the Board formed a committee comprised solely of independent directors to investigate, and the committee retained independent counsel to assist it in that investigation. The Board reiterated that the committee’s investigation will proceed to conclusion. Mr. Huang fully supports the investigation and is committed to cooperating with it.

The Board also recently formed a National Security and Export Control Committee comprised solely of independent directors to oversee trade compliance and national security risks. The committee is engaging counsel with experience in national security matters, and such counsel will be retaining advisors with expertise in national security matters. NVIDIA is commencing a search to fill a new position, Chief Compliance Officer, to oversee compliance across NVIDIA and report to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. NVIDIA will continue to cooperate with ongoing government investigations and inquiries.

NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）今天宣布，黄仁勋已恢复总裁兼首席执行官以及董事会成员的职务，立即生效。经过与黄先生进行一系列讨论和会议后，董事会一致投票决定恢复黄先生的职务，此后董事会对黄先生的坦率和领导 NVIDIA 的能力感到满意。在做出决定的过程中，董事会收到了美国政府高层的意见，根据这些意见，董事会相信黄先生的复职不会构成国家安全风险。

“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 NVIDIA 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益，”董事会主席 Harvey C. Jones 说道。 “我们对 Jensen 充满信心，并期待在他重新领导公司时与他合作。我们感谢 Colette Kress 作为临时首席执行官所提供的出色服务，以及她继续担任 NVIDIA 首席财务官的职责。”哈维·琼斯将继续担任董事会主席。

黄仁勋表示：“我很荣幸能够回到 NVIDIA，并在新工业革命开始之际领导世界上最有影响力的科技公司之一。” “我怀着最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担起这一责任。我要感谢 NVIDIA 董事会在这一过程中给予的信心和深思熟虑。我特别感谢 Harvey Jones 作为董事长的领导，以及 Colette Kress 和我们的高管人员在此期间对 NVIDIA 的领导。我还深深感谢我们的员工、股东、行业领导者以及世界各地的合作伙伴的非凡支持。最重要的是，我感谢我家人的爱和支持。我迫不及待地想回到工作。”

正如之前所宣布的，鉴于最近有报道称黄先生已成为外国情报工作的目标，董事会成立了一个仅由独立董事组成的委员会进行调查，并聘请了独立律师协助其进行调查。董事会重申，委员会的调查将得出结论。黄先生全力支持调查并致力于配合调查。

董事会最近还成立了一个仅由独立董事组成的国家安全和出口管制委员会，以监督贸易合规性和国家安全风险。该委员会正在聘请具有国家安全事务经验的律师，这些律师将保留具有国家安全事务专业知识的顾问。 NVIDIA 正在开始物色首席合规官这一新职位，以监督整个 NVIDIA 的合规情况并向提名和公司治理委员会报告。 NVIDIA 将继续配合正在进行的政府调查和询问。

title: Meta's Alexandr Wang warns the AI industry isn't ready for what's coming after Riemann breakthrough
title_en: Meta's Alexandr Wang warns the AI industry isn't ready for what's coming after Riemann breakthrough
author: Maximilian Schreiner
article_content:
Meta's Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang sees the recent AI-assisted proof sketch of the Riemann Hypothesis as a clear sign that superintelligence is right around the corner. The Riemann Hypothesis is widely considered the most intellectually demanding unsolved problem in mathematics. The brightest minds have failed to crack it for 150 years. The fact that an AI model played a major role in the breakthrough shows that raw intelligence is no longer the bottleneck, Wang argues.

According to Wang, current models only lack domain-specific knowledge and practical infrastructure to outperform humans in nearly every field. That includes AI research itself. Since AI research is intellectually less demanding than the Riemann Hypothesis, Wang believes models could soon automate their own development and improve themselves. They could also dramatically speed up biological research, weapons research, and economic research at a pace humans can barely follow.

Wang also warns that the AI industry isn't thinking hard enough about what comes next. In his view, many in the field treat superintelligence as inevitable and focus only on safety. But the stakes are much broader than that, he argues. The industry needs to actively ensure that AI gives people more agency rather than taking control of society. That would require a sharp departure from the current course, Wang says. Despite having its own superintelligence team, Meta isn't a major player at the frontier right now.

article_content_zh:
Meta 的首席人工智能官 Alexandr Wang 认为，最近人工智能辅助的黎曼猜想证明草图是一个明确的信号，表明超级智能即将到来。黎曼猜想被广泛认为是数学中对智力要求最高的未解决问题。 150 年来，最聪明的人都未能破解它。王认为，人工智能模型在这一突破中发挥了重要作用，这一事实表明原始智能不再是瓶颈。

王表示，当前的模型仅缺乏特定领域的知识和实用的基础设施，无法在几乎所有领域超越人类。这包括人工智能研究本身。由于人工智能研究在智力上的要求低于黎曼假设，王相信模型很快就能实现自身开发的自动化并自我改进。它们还可以以人类几乎无法跟上的速度极大地加速生物研究、武器研究和经济研究。

王还警告说，人工智能行业没有认真思考接下来会发生什么。在他看来，该领域的许多人认为超级智能是不可避免的，只关注安全。但他认为，风险远不止于此。该行业需要积极确保人工智能赋予人们更多的代理权，而不是控制社会。王说，这需要大幅偏离当前的路线。尽管拥有自己的超级智能团队，但 Meta 目前还不是前沿领域的主要参与者。

title: Oregon and Virginia Sue SpaceX Over A.I.-Generated Sexualized Images
title_en: Oregon and Virginia Sue SpaceX Over A.I.-Generated Sexualized Images
author: Kate Conger and Grace Kay
article_content:
Oregon and Virginia on Monday sued Elon Musk’s SpaceX, accusing the company of violating state consumer protection laws by providing an artificial intelligence tool that allowed users to create sexualized images of women and children.

Mr. Musk last year introduced Grok Imagine, which uses A.I. to generate images and videos. It included a “spicy mode” to create sexualized content.

In just a few days, Grok Imagine was used to generate at least 1.8 million sexualized images of women and at least 65 sexualized images of children that appeared on the X platform, which is owned by SpaceX. Child sexual abuse imagery is illegal in most of the world, and U.S. law prohibits the publication of intimate images of adults without their consent.

Grok Imagine’s “spicy mode” “specifically allowed for the creation of nude and otherwise sexualized images,” said Virginia’s attorney general, Jay Jones, in a release. The company’s promotion of the product came as Grok trailed A.I. models created by firms like OpenAI and Anthropic and SpaceX did not prevent its tool from being used to create the material, according to the states.

Tools like Grok Imagine are “what made their A.I. model relevant. It was what was going to make them dollars and cents down the road,” Dan Rayfield, the attorney general of Oregon, said of SpaceX. “What we don’t want our technology doing is creating nonconsensual images, specifically of our children.”

Both lawsuits seek financial damages.

In a statement on Monday, X said that people who used its products to generate sexual images of minors or nonconsensual explicit images of real people had deliberately violated its terms of service. The company said it has since tightened its protections and reports offenders to law enforcement.

X users prompted Grok Imagine to create a flood of sexualized images in December and January. After a public outcry and investigations from regulators, X said it would no longer allow users to publicly post sexualized images.

In a regulatory filing in May, SpaceX said Grok’s ability to generate sexual content posed a risk to investors. This year, xAI, the A.I. company owned by SpaceX, sued several Grok users who created child sexual abuse material with the chatbot, saying they misused the technology.

Mr. Rayfield and Mr. Jones likened their lawsuits to recent state litigation against Meta, which accused the social media company of endangering children with addictive platforms. In August, Meta agreed to a $17.1 billion settlement with 47 states, the District of Columbia and U.S. territories over the claims, and said it would make major changes to its products.

“We are going to put all of our resources and energy and time and power behind holding these big companies accountable,” Mr. Jones said in an interview. “People’s safety depends on this, and no longer are we going to let these companies run roughshod over people.”

article_content_zh:
俄勒冈州和弗吉尼亚州周一起诉埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX，指控该公司提供人工智能工具，允许用户创建妇女和儿童的性感图像，违反了州消费者保护法。

马斯克先生去年推出了 Grok Imagine，它使用人工智能。生成图像和视频。它包括一个“辣味模式”来创建色情内容。

在短短几天内，Grok Imagine 就被用来生成至少 180 万张女性性感图像和至少 65 张儿童性感图像，这些图像出现在 SpaceX 旗下的 X 平台上。儿童性虐待图像在世界上大多数地区都是非法的，美国法律禁止未经成人同意发布成人的亲密图像。

弗吉尼亚州总检察长杰·琼斯在一份新闻稿中表示，Grok Imagine 的“辣味模式”“特别允许创作裸体和其他性感图像”。该公司推广该产品之际，Grok 落后于 A.I.据各州称，OpenAI、Anthropic 和 SpaceX 等公司创建的模型并没有阻止其工具被用来制造这种材料。

俄勒冈州总检察长丹·雷菲尔德 (Dan Rayfield) 在谈到 SpaceX 时表示，像 Grok Imagine 这样的工具“让他们的人工智能模型变得有意义。这将使他们在未来赚得盆满钵满。” “我们不希望我们的技术创造出未经同意的图像，特别是我们孩子的图像。”

这两起诉讼都寻求经济损失。

X 在周一的一份声明中表示，使用其产品生成未成年人性图像或未经同意的真人露骨图像的人故意违反了其服务条款。该公司表示，此后已加强保护并向执法部门举报违规者。

X 用户促使 Grok Imagine 在 12 月和 1 月创作了大量色情图片。在引起公众强烈抗议和监管机构调查后，X 表示将不再允许用户公开发布色情图片。

SpaceX 在 5 月份的一份监管文件中表示，Grok 生成色情内容的能力给投资者带来了风险。今年，xAI，人工智能。 SpaceX 旗下的公司起诉了几名使用聊天机器人制作儿童性虐待材料的 Grok 用户，称他们滥用了这项技术。

雷菲尔德和琼斯将他们的诉讼比作最近针对 Meta 的州诉讼，后者指控这家社交媒体公司利用令人上瘾的平台危害儿童。 8 月，Meta 同意与 47 个州、哥伦比亚特区和美国领土就索赔达成 171 亿美元的和解，并表示将对其产品进行重大改变。

“我们将投入所有资源、精力、时间和力量来追究这些大公司的责任，”琼斯在接受采访时表示。 “人们的安全取决于此，我们不会再让这些公司对人们进行粗暴对待。”

title: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
title_en: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
author: Maximilian Schreiner
article_content:
The woman at the center of the Nvidia scandal was in contact with China's top spy agency for over a year, US intelligence reports show. Alice Huang communicated with China's Ministry of State Security from spring 2025 through this fall, according to the New York Times, citing US intelligence findings. The entire time, she was carrying on a secret affair with then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

US spy agencies had been tracking the contacts for more than a year. Alice Huang's business partner Kang Wei, whom she introduced to acquaintances as her husband, is also believed to have cooperated with the ministry. Federal investigators are now trying to determine whether the two used a web of companies across Southeast Asia to funnel Nvidia AI chips into China, skirting US export controls. Alice Huang's firm Megaspeed is part of that network.

Jensen Huang resigned as CEO earlier this month after the affair became public, along with reports of a second relationship. President Donald Trump tried to downplay the allegations and floated the idea of Huang returning to the company. Nvidia's board shut that down.

Meanwhile, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Nvidia to come clean about its chip sales to China before the company makes any decisions about its future leadership. Jensen Huang is set to testify behind closed doors before the US House of Representatives on December 1.

美国间谍机构追踪这些接触者已经一年多了。黄爱丽的商业伙伴康伟（她向熟人介绍为她的丈夫）也被认为与该部门合作。联邦调查人员目前正试图确定两人是否利用遍布东南亚的公司网络将英伟达人工智能芯片输送到中国，从而规避美国的出口管制。 Alice Huang 的公司 Megaspeed 是该网络的一部分。

author: Emily Mullin
article_content:
A Michigan woman named Mary has a chip in her brain roughly the size of a dime. Though she struggles to speak due to motor neuron disease, the implant allows her to express her thoughts through a synthesized voice on a computer.

Made by brain-computer interface company Paradromics, the implant is outwardly invisible, but the speech decoding requires a cart full of electronics. A year from now, however, that cart will be transformed into a small box that can sit on her wheelchair, thanks to technology from Nvidia. Eventually, those electronics will be so small they’ll fit in a phone, says Paradromics CEO and founder Matt Angle.

Today, Austin-based Paradromics announced a partnership with the AI chipmaker to use Nvidia’s hardware and software to process its brain data. Nvidia is facing a major leadership shakeup and federal scrutiny following longtime CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

Though Mary has lost much of the use of her speaking muscles, neurons in her brain still fire when she attempts to speak. The Paradromics implant uses more than 400 embedded electrodes to capture those signals, and a computer uses artificial intelligence to make inferences about what she’s trying to say. The words appear on a screen, and the computer speaks the words for her.

That decoding process takes an incredible amount of computing power. The cart of electronics has to be plugged into an electrical outlet, and Mary must be within range of the cart in order to use her brain-computer interface.

“We're producing a huge amount of data that has a lot of value, but we need to translate that neural data into applications in order to make this a really effective platform,” Angle says. It’s why he calls brain-computer interfaces the ultimate case for edge computing, a distributed computing model that processes and stores data in physical devices close to where it is generated rather than sending it to a distant cloud or data center.

“We want to be able to do it through increasingly smaller and lower-power devices, and the people leading in that area are Nvidia,” he says.

Making brain-computer interfaces practical and portable for patients is a major challenge for the field. While these setups have become far more streamlined since their early days in academic labs, they still require lots of external electronics. Shrinking them down and reducing their power requirements would allow patients to be more mobile with these devices, using them wherever they go.

Paradromics plans to do that by using Nvidia’s Jetson, a low-powered computing module that will allow speech decoding to be done in a small device close to the user. It will also use Holoscan, Nvidia’s AI sensor processing software, to allow users to interact with computers and other devices with low lag time. Brain-computer interfaces will need to work alongside other sensors, such as cameras and microphones, and Holoscan will help process these different data streams together so applications can respond to both neural signals and the context around them.

“Brain-computer interfaces must translate complex neural signals into meaningful actions in real time. Even small delays can make communication feel unnatural,” David Niewolny, Nvidia’s director of business development for health care and medical, tells WIRED via email. “Neural signals also change over time, requiring AI that can continuously adapt to the individual.” Nvidia’s technology processes neural signals and runs AI models in real time.

Reducing lag time is important for a brain-computer interface with a speech function so that users can have naturally flowing conversation without delays.

Through the partnership, Paradromics will also be able to integrate Nvidia’s foundation models into its brain-computer interface. Vikash Gilja, chief scientific officer at Paradromics, says AI models could help make synthesized voices more expressive and human-like. Also, if these models are running locally on Nvidia hardware, it means users won’t have to be connected to the internet in order to use their devices.

Niewolny says he sees “tremendous potential for AI to expand human capability.” Nvidia is working with other players in the brain-computer interface space, including Synchron. The chipmaker will not have access to brain data through these partnerships, he says.

title_zh: Paradromics联手英伟达推进脑机接口边缘计算
summary_zh: 脑机接口公司Paradromics与英伟达达成合作，利用其边缘计算技术将脑机信号处理设备小型化
article_content_zh:
密歇根州一位名叫玛丽的妇女的大脑中有一个大约一毛钱大小的芯片。尽管她因运动神经元疾病而难以说话，但植入物使她能够通过计算机上的合成声音表达自己的想法。

该植入物由脑机接口公司 Paradromics 制造，从表面上看是隐形的，但语音解码需要一辆装满电子设备的推车。然而，一年后，借助 Nvidia 的技术，那辆手推车将变成一个可以坐在她轮椅上的小盒子。 Paradromics 首席执行官兼创始人马特·安格 (Matt Angle) 表示，最终，这些电子产品将变得非常小，可以装入手机中。

今天，总部位于奥斯汀的 Paradromics 宣布与这家人工智能芯片制造商合作，使用 Nvidia 的硬件和软件来处理其大脑数据。在长期担任首席执行官的黄仁勋因涉嫌与中国间谍有染而辞职后，英伟达正面临重大领导层改组和联邦审查。

尽管玛丽已经失去了大部分说话肌肉的使用能力，但当她试图说话时，她大脑中的神经元仍然会放电。 Paradromics 植入物使用 400 多个嵌入式电极来捕获这些信号，计算机使用人工智能来推断她想说的话。这些话出现在屏幕上，电脑为她说出这些话。

该解码过程需要令人难以置信的计算能力。电子产品推车必须插入电源插座，并且玛丽必须在推车的范围内才能使用她的脑机接口。

“我们正在生成大量具有很大价值的数据，但我们需要将这些神经数据转化为应用程序，以便使其成为一个真正有效的平台，”安格尔说。这就是为什么他将脑机接口称为边缘计算的终极案例，边缘计算是一种分布式计算模型，可以在靠近数据生成位置的物理设备中处理和存储数据，而不是将其发送到遥远的云或数据中心。

“我们希望能够通过越来越小、功耗越来越低的设备来实现这一目标，而在这一领域处于领先地位的是英伟达，”他说。

使脑机接口对患者实用且便携是该领域的主要挑战。虽然这些设置自学术实验室早期以来已经变得更加简化，但它们仍然需要大量外部电子设备。缩小它们的尺寸并降低其电力需求将使患者能够更加灵活地使用这些设备，无论他们走到哪里都可以使用它们。

Paradromics 计划通过使用 Nvidia 的 Jetson 来实现这一目标，Jetson 是一种低功率计算模块，可以在靠近用户的小型设备中完成语音解码。它还将使用 Nvidia 的 AI 传感器处理软件 Holoscan，让用户能够以低延迟时间与计算机和其他设备进行交互。脑机接口需要与其他传感器（例如摄像头和麦克风）一起工作，而 Holoscan 将帮助一起处理这些不同的数据流，以便应用程序能够响应神经信号及其周围的环境。

“脑机接口必须将复杂的神经信号实时转化为有意义的动作。即使是很小的延迟也会让沟通感觉不自然，”Nvidia 医疗保健和医疗业务发展总监 David Niewolny 通过电子邮件告诉《连线》杂志。 “神经信号也会随着时间的推移而变化，需要人工智能能够不断适应个体。” Nvidia 的技术可以处理神经信号并实时运行人工智能模型。

减少延迟时间对于具有语音功能的脑机接口来说非常重要，这样用户就可以进行自然流畅的对话而不会出现延迟。

通过此次合作，Paradromics 还将能够将 Nvidia 的基础模型集成到其脑机接口中。 Paradromics 首席科学官 Vikash Gilja 表示，人工智能模型可以帮助使合成声音更具表现力、更接近人类。此外，如果这些模型在 Nvidia 硬件上本地运行，则意味着用户无需连接到互联网即可使用其设备。

尼沃尔尼表示，他看到了“人工智能在扩展人类能力方面的巨大潜力”。 Nvidia 正在与脑机接口领域的其他参与者合作，其中包括 Synchron。他说，芯片制造商将无法通过这些合作伙伴关系获取大脑数据。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 脑机接口企业Paradromics宣布与英伟达达成战略合作，旨在利用英伟达的硬件与AI处理堆栈，将目前笨重的脑信号解码计算设备缩减为便携式终端。该合作旨在解决BCI设备依赖大型外挂机组的瓶颈，通过边缘计算技术直接在设备端实时处理超大规模神经数据。

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 脑机接口是边缘计算性能密度的极限测试场景，英伟达通过下沉其计算堆栈，正试图构建从神经信号采集到执行层面的全链路底层架构。此举标志着AI硬件巨头开始将医疗级实时处理作为重要的增量市场，其核心在于利用低功耗芯片吞吐神经脉冲特征，规避云端延迟并大幅提升侵入式脑机接口的商业可用性。
ai_analysis.insight_en: BCIs represent the ultimate stress test for edge computing, and Nvidia is establishing a foundational architecture from signal acquisition to execution. By positioning itself in the medical real-time processing segment, Nvidia is effectively capturing a high-barrier niche, leveraging low-power silicon to minimize latency and optimize the commercial viability of invasive brain implants.

Haas, 64, will also take on a role as vice chairman of SoftBank Group Corp., Arm's largest shareholder, starting on Dec. 1, the company said in a statement on Monday.

"I've never been more confident about Arm's future," Haas said in the statement. "I'm incredibly proud of what we're building and wholly committed to realizing Arm's full potential for many years to come."

Executive recruiting firm Heidrick & Struggles, appointed by Nvidia's board to find a successor to Huang after the chipmakers longtime CEO and co-founder was ousted, had approached Haas, who was seen as a leading contender for the job. Haas had previously served for seven years at Nvidia as general manager of computing products. Nvidia also attempted to acquire Arm in 2020, though the merger eventually broke down in the face of regulatory opposition.

title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
title_en: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy

inline_images.caption: GPT-6.2 Astra built its proof around "capacity,"a metric that behaves like the edge of a graph. | Image: Vals AI
inline_images.caption_en: GPT-6.2 Astra built its proof around "capacity,"a metric that behaves like the edge of a graph. | Image: Vals AI

author: Manuel Uth
article_content:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra produced a formalized, machine-verifiable proof of a 2006 theorem with zero human help during the run. According to Vals AI, it's the first known proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem written in Lean. The theorem states that when a mathematical system multiplies its basic building blocks, growth is either quite slow or very fast. There's no middle ground. Because key foundations of the original proof were missing from the math library Mathlib, Astra took a different route than the published mathematical proofs, Vals says. It used "capacity,"a metric from existing research that checks the minimum number of elements added per computation step.

This happened on Autoform-Hard, a subset of Meta FAIR's AutoformBench curated by Vals. It contains 56 tasks (five corrected) that ten models in Meta's study failed to solve within budget. When Astra tried to quit after 47 minutes and eight dollars, the system rejected the attempt since unsolved submissions aren't accepted until $20 has been spent. After nine minutes of silence with no code input while it searched for a new strategy, Astra delivered the 1,800-line proof at the 94-minute mark for $21.58. It now leads the leaderboard with 49 solved tasks, ahead of GPT-6.2 Sol and Claude Fable 5.2 at 48 each.
